title: Allow authenticated propagation of newer DODAG versions across multiple hops
description: rust/lichen-node/src/routing/router.rs and rust/lichen-rpl/src/dodag.rs classify a DIO as root-authorized only when the immediate link signer derives to the DODAGID, then reject any version change from a peer. RPL DIOs are re-originated/relayed by non-root parents, so nodes more than one hop from the root can never adopt a root-triggered DODAGVersionNumber increment and global repair partitions the mesh. Add a separately verifiable root-owned version authorization that peers can propagate (or another spec-defined authenticated mechanism) while retaining rejection of unauthorized peer version changes.
close_reason: Root-signed DODAG version authorization (option 0x16, Schnorr48 over LICHEN-RPL-DODAG-VERSION-v1 transcript) verified and propagated by non-root parents; lollipop floor rejects stale/replayed authorizations. Added negative tests (garbage sig, non-root key, mismatch, duplicate, truncated, stale version, idempotent replay) using canonical vectors from test/vectors/dodag_version_authorization.json; fixed dao_parents_for_source transit-group flush regression and runtime.rs Ipv6Addr compile break. cargo test -p lichen-rpl (233/233 lib + 54 integration) and lichen-node (266/267 lib, sole failure pre-existing secure.rs blockwise owned elsewhere) pass; clippy/fmt clean.
